finalText:
**Root cause.** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14Z) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That change exhausted the connection pool at its max of 20, so every upstream call started failing with 503.

**Impact window.** First 503 at 02:14:18Z. Still failing at 03:59:27Z, the last line in the log, so it was ongoing when the log was captured. Only the gateway was hit — `worker.log` shows workers on a separate pool, healthy the whole time.

**Rollback.** Revert `dep-4471` on gateway, or just flip `gateway.pool.perRequest` back to `false`. That's the only deploy that touches the gateway that night.

Every failure repeats the same signature:
```
ERROR access  req-XXXXX <path> -> <svc> 503 <latency>ms
ERROR pool    req-XXXXX ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```
`waiting` climbs from 13 to 74+ by the end, confirming it never recovered on its own.
